messages:
Nora (Product): Putting this thread up for the UX pass on the Private/VPC setup wizard  particularly the connectivity step for multi-host deployments. Found a few flow breakdowns when customers have >20 hosts and on narrow screens. Recording + notes: https://redwood.design/s/multi-host-conn
Diego (Design): Thanks. Main issues: the dense table is overwhelming and action buttons get pushed off-canvas on small widths. Proposal: switch to accordion-style host rows that support batch selection. Each row shows host icon, short name, status dot, and a chevron to expand details.
Kai (Engineering): Accordion works. We'll need to handle batch actions (retry selected, open combined logs) carefully to avoid large payloads. For client-side layout: ``` .host-row { display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:center; } .host-name { min-width:0; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; } ``` Keeps Ctas visible.
Samira (Accessibility): Accessibility notes: accordion must use button semantics with aria-expanded and aria-controls. For batch selection use checkboxes with aria-checked and an action toolbar that appears when at least one is selected. Announce changes to the selection count with a polite aria-live region (eg. "3 hosts selected").
Ben (PM): Copy thoughts: don't surface raw probe codes. Replace messages like 'conn_err_1001' with user-facing text: 'Connection refused  Check host firewall, security groups, or SSH service.' For batch retry tooltip: 'Retry connectivity checks for selected hosts.'
Diego (Design): Visual tokens: status dot + pill. In dark theme the dot alone is ambiguous; pair with a label or a subtle border. We'll provide a variant where the pill contains the word (Passed/Failed/Skipped) on small widths to help clarity.
Kai (Engineering): Implementation detail: debounce UI state updates (200-300ms) to avoid noisy screen reader announcements when multiple probes flip quickly. For combined logs view let's stream the first 200 lines and provide a 'load more' button to fetch additional lines on demand.
Samira (Accessibility): Keyboard behavior: arrow keys should navigate between hosts when the accordion list is focused; Enter toggles expand. When expanding, focus moves into the panel header, and the expanded panel should have role=region and aria-labelledby referencing the host button. For the combined logs, ensure the 'Load more' control is keyboard reachable and has descriptive aria-labels (e.g., 'Load more logs for host X').
Nora (Product): Edge case: admins can disable probes for privacy (air-gapped). For that case show a muted info row 'External probes disabled by deployment policy' and an inline 'Why?' link that opens the admin policy modal. Also prevent batch actions from including these hosts (disable checkbox + tooltip explaining why).
Ben (PM): Acceptance criteria I'll add: 1) accordion host rows on widths <= 560px with truncation and chevrons, 2) batch-select toolbar with accessible selection count announcement, 3) debounced aria-live messages for probe summary updates, 4) replace technical probe codes with actionable microcopy and KB links, 5) combined logs stream with 'load more' that is keyboardable.
Diego (Design): I'll upload a Figma file showing the accordion + batch toolbar + dark-theme variants. Will include color tokens and copy strings. Link in ~3h.
Kai (Engineering): I'll prototype the accordion and batch toolbar in the client next sprint; will include an automated a11y test asserting aria-expanded toggles and the selection announcer text. Also will cap combined logs streaming to 200 lines by default.
ci-bot: Reminder: usability walkthrough scheduled in #product at 16:00  bring mobile prototype :bell:
Nora (Product): Thanks all. If anyone notices unclear microcopy for the admin modal or selection tooltips, drop suggestions here and I'll consolidate before the Figma review.
